title: Settings model (pydantic-settings, PRD §7)
prompt:
In packages/core, add a pydantic-settings Settings class with every PRD §7 field and sane defaults (ROUNDS=10, MAX_WORDS=150, TURN_TIMEOUT_S=60, MAX_RETRIES=2, SEARCH_BACKEND=duckduckgo). Load from environment and .env.

Follow repo standards: TDD (write the failing test first, then code); max 150 lines per code file (split, don't compress); ruff = 0 violations + mypy clean; no hard-coded values (read from config); every external API call goes through the API gatekeeper (Epic 13); log via the LOG package; keep coverage >= 85%. Read docs/PRD.md and the relevant docs/prds/*.md before starting.
note: Adds the runtime config model for agent_debate (Closes #21). TDD red-first: wrote packages/core/tests/test_settings.py first and watched it fail (ImportError: cannot import name 'Settings'), then implemented. Defaults live once in packages/core/src/agent_debate/core/constants.py (DEFAULT_* — single source of truth per guideline §7.2, no scattered literals); settings.py references them, so file split keeps both well under the 150-line gate. Settings is a pydantic_settings.BaseSettings with SettingsConfigDict(env_file='.env', env_file_encoding='utf-8', extra='ignore', case_sensitive=False) and NO env prefix (PRD §7 vars are bare names like ROUNDS/DEBATER_MODEL). Fields map 1:1 to PRD §7; PRO_MODEL/CON_MODEL bind via alias='PRO_MODEL'/'CON_MODEL' onto pro_model_override/con_model_override. REQUIRED-KEY handling: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is typed Optional[str]=None so importing/instantiating Settings never explodes during test collection or in key-free packages — strict 'fail fast with a clear error when the key is missing' validation is deliberately deferred to task 2.3 (noted inline). PER-SIDE FALLBACK implemented here as computed properties: pro_model returns pro_model_override or debater_model; con_model returns con_model_override or debater_model. Also added get_settings() (functools.lru_cache singleton) that logs a 'settings_loaded' debug event via the LOG package (get_logger) — no external API calls in this task, so the API gatekeeper (Epic 13) is N/A. Re-exported Settings + get_settings from agent_debate.core __init__. Added pydantic>=2.9,<3 + pydantic-settings>=2.5,<3 to packages/core deps and ran uv lock (resolved pydantic-settings 2.14.1 + python-dotenv 1.2.2). Tests use monkeypatch (env injection + chdir to an isolated tmp dir so no ambient .env leaks); the .env test writes a real .env into that cwd; avoided pydantic-settings' runtime-only _env_file kwarg because mypy strict flags it as an unknown call-arg. Gates green locally: uv sync clean; ruff check . = All checks passed; ruff format --check . = clean; mypy = no issues in 40 source files; pytest --cov = 154 passed, 100% total coverage (Required 85.0% reached); check_line_limit.py exits 0; secret_scan.py exits 0 (only clearly-fake dummy tokens, tests/ excluded by the scanner). .env.example already listed every PRD §7 var, confirming field-name parity.
